_readme: Curated seed of REAL, publicly-filed planned projects — STATEWIDE superset of data/seeds/projects_seed.json. All 73 original records retained verbatim (Savannah River corridor + statewide coverage), plus additional real planned projects across Georgia (SERTP 2026 / GA ITS: metro Atlanta incl. Adamsville-East Point, Union City-Line Creek-Yates, Villa Rica-Wansley-Cavender corridors; Athens-Watkinsville-Winder; Macon-Warner Robins; Columbus-LaGrange-West Point-Farley; Albany/Valdosta/Moultrie; Rome-Bowen-Judy Mountain; Gainesville-Cornelia-Toccoa; Commerce-Middle Fork-East Walton; central GA Gordon-Sandersville-Warthen-Tomochichi-Rum Creek) and South Carolina (SCRTP 2026-2030 & 2024-2028 DESC filings: Charleston metro incl. Cainhoy-Clements Ferry-Jack Primus taps, Church Creek-Dawson-Faber Place; Columbia incl. VCS1-Denny Terrace/Pineland, Wateree-Killian/Hopkins, Scout/Millrace/Clements taps; Midlands Orangeburg-Cameron-Elloree; Pee Dee Conway-Marion-Red Bluff-Kingstree; Lowcountry Canadys-Ritter-Yemassee-Varnville; Santee Cooper committed table incl. Conway SS/Perry Rd, Varnville-Nixville, Indian Field, Batesburg). Every record cites a public source URL (SCRTP/SERTP plan docs, SC PSC dockets, GA ITS/IRPs). location_confidence: verified = named facility coordinate confirmed (OSM/HIFLD); endpoint_only = straight line between verified/named endpoint substations; approximate = town/site/community centroid or documented siting description, exact pad unpublished. NO fabricated entries; projects that could not be honestly located are omitted (see notes). Utility labels follow the existing seed (GPC, DESC, SanteeCooper, MEAG, GTC, DU, DukeCarolinas, DukeProgress — GTC/DU/Duke* exceed the Utility literal in src/spatial/schema.py but the ProjectProps.utility field is typed str).
